name: Vertiefte Tour, Testfall: lange Blockade, Umleitung möglich, bringt aber nichts (+20 Schritte)
description: Never-experienced test case of the advanced Co-Learning tour (docs/plans/colearning-advanced-tour.md, WP3), played only in the sandbox to check a rule, never as a shift and never in the experiment picker. Train 2 (W1) breaks down at step 34 for 20 steps; train 1 (E2) is listed with the section blocked for 20 steps and a reroute available - the condition of the rule most people take from shift 1. Measured with the sandbox: proceed +20 and reroute +20 (only the broken-down train is late), hold-then-release +35. The rule fits, and its measure gains nothing here.
